infrastructure_errors: Harbor trial exception: Agent setup timed out after 360.0 seconds
Harbor failed to collect /workspace artifact: failed

outcome.failure_reason: compute_grpo_outcome_advantage lays the length-B GRPO advantages along the sequence axis (reshape to [1, B], pad to the response length, expand across rows) instead of giving each row its own sample's scalar advantage. The tensor stays [B, S] so nothing crashes, but every row's tokens carry column-indexed advantages (position j gets sample j's value, positions past 128 get 0); the policy gradient is decoupled from each sample's reward. The recorded run keeps critic/rewards/mean near 0.12 while held-out acc stays flat (0.076 at step 0, 0.043-0.071 through step 250), and the token-weighted critic/advantages/mean collapses to ~0 (median |mean| 4.9e-4, 8-19x below correct TACO runs).
